# NexVora MV Studio — Documentation
NexVora MV Studio is a browser-based lyric video studio (Bangla and English UI). Import audio and lyrics (plain text, LRC, word-level LRC), time lyrics line by line or word by word, choose a lyric animation and background, then export MP4 (H.264/AAC) or WebM (VP9/Opus) when the browser supports those encoders.

Features: NexVora Glow (glowing audio-reactive lyrics with particles and waveform), 20 additional lyric animations, custom image/GIF/video backgrounds, local fonts and Google Fonts, waveform timeline, undo/redo, local project saving (IndexedDB) and downloadable .lyricmv project files, transparent lyric-layer WebM export (browser dependent).

Privacy: media is processed on the device. Optional analytics are disabled unless the deployer sets environment variables.
